name: elmah.io

evidence.errors: C02: error monitoring for .NET and JavaScript; grouping in E01
evidence.uptime: U01, U02: HTTP and MCP checks every 5 minutes from selected regions (U03)
evidence.logs: L02: full-text and field search over stored log messages
evidence.cron: J01, J02: expected interval with grace period and missing-heartbeat errors

line: Collects .NET errors and logs, plus uptime checks and job heartbeats.

errors.math: 5,000 messages fit the Business plan's allowance, for one builder and three apps.
50,000 messages fit the Business+ plan, with 30-day detail.
500,000 messages need the Business+ plan plus 10 manual top-ups.

uptime.math: Only a partial bundle with five-minute checks is priced. The 60-second checks and own-domain page you need aren't priced.
